disableaccount-desc: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa maamulayaasha inay damiyaan akoonnada shaqsiyeed
disableaccount-confirm:
Dami akoonkan isticmaalaha.
Isticmaaluhu ma awoodi doono inuu soo galo, dib u dejiyo furaha sirta ah, ama helo ogeysiisyada iimaylka.
Haddii isticmaaluhu hadda meel ka soo galay, isla markiiba waa laga saari doonaa.
''Ogow in daminta akoonka aan dib looga noqon karin haddii aanu maamule nidaamku faragelin.''
disableaccount-mustconfirm: Waa inaad xaqiijisaa inaad doonayso inaad damiso akoonkan.
disableaccount-success: Akoonka isticmaalaha "$1" si joogto ah ayaa loo damiyay.
